title: 1957 UFOs head toward Eisenhower's summer White House

tellings.quote: UFO researcher Brad Sparks thoroughly documented a UFO heading towards Eisenhower's summerh home in 1957

plain: In 1957, Michels says, a UFO was tracked heading toward President Eisenhower's summer home. He credits the UFO researcher Brad Sparks with documenting it "thoroughly" from records of NORAD, the North American air-defense command, and of Project Blue Book, the US Air Force's UFO study of the 1950s and 60s. If so, an unknown object was moving toward the president himself, and the government wrote it down.
